    14  /-!
    15  # The singular simplicial set of a topological space and geometric realization of a simplicial set
    16  
    17  The *singular simplicial set* `TopCat.toSSet.obj X` of a topological space `X`
    18  has `n`-simplices which identify to continuous maps `stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) → X`,
    19  where `stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1))` is the standard topological `n`-simplex,
    20  defined as the subtype of `Fin (n + 1) → ℝ` consisting of functions `f`
    21  such that `0 ≤ f i` for all `i` and `∑ i, f i = 1`.
    22  
    23  The *geometric realization* functor `SSet.toTop` is left adjoint to `TopCat.toSSet`.
    24  It is the left Kan extension of `SimplexCategory.toTop` along the Yoneda embedding.
    25  
    26  ## Main definitions
    27  
    28  * `TopCat.toSSet : TopCat ⥤ SSet` is the functor
    29    assigning the singular simplicial set to a topological space.
    30  * `SSet.toTop : SSet ⥤ TopCat` is the functor
    31    assigning the geometric realization to a simplicial set.
    32  * `sSetTopAdj : SSet.toTop ⊣ TopCat.toSSet` is the adjunction between these two functors.
    33  
    34  ## TODO (@joelriou)
    35  
    36  - Show that the singular simplicial set is a Kan complex.
    37  - Show the adjunction `sSetTopAdj` is a Quillen equivalence.
    38  
    39  -/
    40  
    41  @[expose] public section
    42  
    43  universe u
    44  
    45  open CategoryTheory
    46  
    47  /-- The functor associating the *singular simplicial set* to a topological space.
    48  
    49  Let `X : TopCat.{u}` be a topological space.
    50  Then the singular simplicial set of `X`
    51  has as `n`-simplices the continuous maps `ULift.{u} (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) → X`.
    52  Here, `stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1))` is the standard topological `n`-simplex,
    53  defined as `{ f : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ // (∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) ∧ ∑ i, f i = 1 }` with its subspace topology. -/
    54  noncomputable def TopCat.toSSet : TopCat.{u} ⥤ SSet.{u} :=
    55    Presheaf.restrictedULiftYoneda.{0} SimplexCategory.toTop.{u}
    56  
    57  /-- If `X : TopCat.{u}` and `n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ`,
    58  then `(toSSet.obj X).obj n` identifies to the type of continuous
    59  maps from the standard simplex `stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n.unop.len + 1))` to `X`. -/

    61      (toSSet.obj X).obj n ≃ C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n.unop.len + 1)), X) :=
